description: Multi-objective robust reachability (weighted-sum scalarisation). Etessami-Kwiatkowska-Vardi-Yannakakis TACAS 2007 (achievable set convex; the deterministic weighted-optima are its Pareto vertices); Forejt-Kwiatkowska-Norman-Parker-Qu TACAS 2011.
provenance: Point MDP; from s0 action A -> (P(F t1),P(F t2))=(0.9,0.1), action B -> (0.2,0.8). Pareto frontier = convex hull of these two deterministic vertices.

measured.note: Live 2026-07-01. IMPaCT's Pareto vertices == Storm's '2 Pareto optimal points'; corners == Storm single-objective Pmax[F t1]=0.9, Pmax[F t2]=0.8. For interval MDPs the reported point is what the weight-optimal policy guarantees robustly per objective (a sound achievable point; full robust-Pareto convexity across a single adversarial nature is a documented refinement).
